details: Crude oil prices climbed above $110 a barrel on Monday, May 18, 2026, as escalating tensions in the Middle East, particularly concerns over drone attacks and President Trump's review of military actions, deepened fears of a wider conflict. The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical concern for global oil and gas shipments. This surge in oil prices is fueling inflation concerns, reinforcing expectations for sustained higher interest rates globally.
title: Oil Surges Amid Iran Tensions, Inflation Fears Intensify

details: Investor sentiment in the cryptocurrency market has significantly worsened, with the Crypto Fear & Greed Index falling to 27 on May 17, 2026, signaling "Fear" territory and reaching its lowest point this month. This decline is attributed to increasing volatility across major digital assets, heightened uncertainty in global financial markets, and renewed concerns among traders regarding the short-term direction of cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum. Geopolitical tensions and global economic uncertainty continue to influence investor caution.
title: Crypto Fear Index Hits Monthly Low as Market Anxiety Deepens
